welcome.title: Welcome to the Time Use Tool 👋
welcome.body: In a few steps we'll show you with an example how to record your time. Don't worry: nothing is saved during the tutorial – and you can skip at any time.

dayNav.title: Your days
dayNav.body: Switch between the days of your course here. The bar shows how many of the day's 144 ten-minute slots you've already filled in.

timeGrid.title: Select a time range
timeGrid.body: Each row is an hour, each slot ten minutes. Drag across the slots to select a time range. In this example, 00:00–06:00 is selected.

primaryActivity.title: Choose the main activity
primaryActivity.body: Pick what you mainly did during this time. Activities are sorted into categories, or you can search directly. In this example: “Sleeping” under Personal care.

secondaryActivity.title: Secondary activity – optional
secondaryActivity.body: Were you doing something else at the same time, like listening to music? Then pick it here as a secondary activity – the slot in the grid is then split diagonally. If not, just tap “No secondary activity → Continue”.

device.title: Device use
device.body: Next we ask whether you used a device like a smartphone, tablet or computer – and if so, which one.

location.title: Location
location.body: Here you say where you were – or how you were travelling.

social.title: People and mood
social.body: Finally: who was with you, and how did you feel? Then the entry is saved and the slots in the grid are filled in.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: The overview shows all days of your course – and which ones aren't complete yet.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.body: Statistics shows charts of how you spend your time. Once the admin has enabled it, you can compare your entries with other participants in your course.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Set dark mode and language here. You can also restart this tutorial here at any time.
